instruction: Write an HTML page containing a form that submits to /subscribe via POST with email input and submit button, styled minimally with an internal stylesheet.
output:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <title>Subscribe</title>
  <style>
    form { max-width: 320px; margin: 2rem auto; display: grid; gap: .75rem; }
    input, button { padding: .5rem; font-size: 1rem; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <form action="/subscribe" method="POST">
    <label for="email">Email</label>
    <input id="email" name="email" type="email" required placeholder="you@example.com">
    <button type="submit">Subscribe</button>
  </form>
</body>
</html>
